evidence.title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension

summary: Researchers unveiled CaRGo‑T, an AI system that employs a causal reasoning graph‑of‑thought architecture to integrate visual and textual cues for interpreting humor. The model sets new performance standards on multimodal humor benchmarks, demonstrating the value of structured causal reasoning in complex language‑vision tasks.
title: CaRGo‑T leverages causal reasoning graph‑of‑thought to advance multimodal humor comprehension
